title: Notifications
description: Telegram groups of markets: messages about new and cancelled orders are sent here

list.title: Connected groups
list.hint: New-order and cancelled-order groups of one market are connected separately
list.label: Connected Telegram groups
list.emptyDescription: To connect a market's Telegram group, press "Add notification".
list.loadError: Could not load the list of groups

form.connectTitle: Connect notifications to a Telegram group
form.connectText: First add the bot to the group, then choose the market and enter the group ID. A group ID usually starts with -100.
form.botMissingText: To show the "Add bot to the group" button, add VITE_TELEGRAM_NOTIFICATION_BOT_USERNAME to the .env file.
form.groupIdHint: E.g. -1001234567890. The bot must be added to this group.
form.helpTitle: How to get the group ID?
form.helpStep1: Add the notification bot to the Telegram group.
form.helpStep2: Write a simple message to the group, e.g. test.
form.helpStep3: Take the group's message.chat.id value from the bot log — it usually starts with -100.
form.typeHint: New-order and cancelled-order groups of one market are connected separately.

deleteDialog.title: Do you really want to delete it?

description.create: Messages about new orders of {{market}} will no longer be sent to this group. The group can be connected again later.
description.cancel: Messages about cancelled orders of {{market}} will no longer be sent to this group. The group can be connected again later.
